info.title: Lending Studio local browser API
info.description: Session-scoped browser adapter over existing domain APIs. Every POST/PUT, including referenced Business operations, requires X-CSRF-Token from GET /session plus the same-origin HttpOnly session cookie. Business/AI routes require BUSINESS mode; customer routes require CUSTOMER mode. Owner bodies, version guards, idempotency headers and statuses pass through unchanged. Local demo selection is not production authentication. AI workflow architecture: docs/architecture.md. Typed A2A envelopes: ai-service/src/main/java/com/lending/ai/Contracts.java.

post.description: CLEAR restores working defaults; A2A also prepares approved fixture policies, a customer, draft and unused cohorts. Requests are serialized and UUID-idempotent. Requires the standard local launchers and a single local database/broker. During maintenance, workspace requests return 503; success expires demo identities. Failure keeps maintenance paused until an explicit retry.
